name: Explosive Strength
definition: The ability to use short bursts of muscle force to propel oneself (as in jumping or sprinting), or to throw an object.

benchmark.name: World Humanoid Robot Games
benchmark.model_or_system: Robotera (Xingdong Era) Xingdong L7 humanoid robot
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce (physically active workers for whom explosive strength matters, e.g., laborers, first responders, warehouse staff), not trained jumpers

benchmark.name: World Humanoid Robot Games
benchmark.model_or_system: Tiangong Ultra (Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Center)
benchmark.metric: seconds (100 m sprint time, large-size robot final; lower is better)
benchmark.human_reference: Working adults whose jobs call for short bursts of maximal force, such as laborers, firefighters, law enforcement, military and athletes. The median member is an untrained or moderately fit adult who runs 100 m in roughly 14-17 s.
